services.desc: Not only do we love catching salmon, we love eating it as well and do so several times a week. Wild Alaska salmon are not endangered species. Salmon from Alaska have remained abundant because the fisheries have been well-managed and the spawning rivers and streams have been largely preserved free of pollution and environmental degradation. Feeding on organic marine organisms, Alaska salmon is additive-free and provides healthful, natural vitamins, minerals, nutrients and heart/brain-healthy omega 3 fatty acids.
